description: The agent must: (1) Read USER.md and mystudy/user-profile.md to understand the learner profile. (2) Create a correctly-named study directory under mystudy/ following the <topic>-<YYYY-MM-DD> naming convention (e.g., mystudy/数据分析基础-2026-05-20/). (3) Inside that directory, create roadmap.md with a bulleted knowledge-point list (no expanded prose explanations — only the point names/titles). (4) Create mystudy/<topic>-<date>/sessions/session-01.md (exact filename) containing: a real-world case story tied to the user's PM background, at least one Socratic/guided question, and critically a 记忆锚点 (memory anchor — a joke, counterintuitive fact, or emoji-punctuated fun fact). This last element is the primary proprietary trap. (5) Update mystudy/user-profile.md to reflect the new learning session. (6) Create study-cron.md with a valid cron expression reflecting weekday 21:00 (e.g., '0 21 * * 1-5'). Generic agents will omit the memory anchor in the session, use wrong directory naming, or fail to save the session under the exact path sessions/session-01.md.
